description.zh: 侧栏导航新增「置顶/未读」入口：角标只统计未读数；点一下在图标下方贴左侧栏展开浮层，置顶会话排前、未读会话排后（未读用会话标题旁的小绿点标记，读后自动消失）；点会话立即切换且浮层不收起，行尾可取消置顶。
description.en: Adds a Pinned/Unread entry to the sidebar navigation: the badge counts unread sessions only. One click expands a floating list inside the left column — pinned first, then unread sessions marked with a small green dot beside the title (they leave the list once read). Switch in one click without closing the list; unpin from a row.
